scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a sentimental mother's birthday, [X] turns her birth month into a custom necklace inquiry, comparing the stone's meaning, chain and setting finishes, price tiers, engraving, and reuse of an inherited stone before commissioning any piece.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为感性的母亲准备生日礼物时，[X]会把她的出生月份推进为定制项链咨询，在尚未委托制作前比较宝石寓意、链条与镶座色泽、价格档、刻字和旧石重制方案。
examples: using Clear or White when the April stone should remain visually central
comparing Silver, Gold, or Rose Gold settings against the recipient's usual wear and the budget
keeping alternative stone colors conditional on family meaning rather than treating a birthstone list as a settled preference

scenarios.scenario_abstract: Within a fixed birthday-date budget, [X] selects a named heart pendant necklace as the surprise gift, then checks its actual finish against the recipient's taste, a lily bouquet, the restaurant atmosphere, and the remaining cash before buying it.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 在固定的生日约会预算内，[X]会选定一条有明确款式的心形吊坠项链作为惊喜礼物，并在购买前结合收礼人的品味、百合花束、餐厅氛围和剩余预算核对实物色泽。
examples: keeping Silver when the selected pendant's cool finish is the confirmed listing
checking a Gold or Rose Gold variant only if the seller offers the same traceable design
rejecting a finish change that makes the necklace compete with the flowers or leaves the total plan over budget

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While completing a formal, glamorous graduation outfit with a multicolored floral dress and chest ruffles, [X] compares earrings, a delicate neck piece, a bracelet, and a ring, deciding whether the jewelry should echo one part of the print, stay neutral, or supply a controlled contrast near the face.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为带多色花卉图案和胸前荷叶边的正式华丽毕业造型做最后搭配时，[X]会在耳饰、细项链、手链和戒指之间比较，决定首饰应呼应印花中的某一部分、保持中性，还是在脸部附近形成受控对比。
examples: using Gold, Silver, or Rose Gold as a quiet finish around an already busy neckline
echoing Pink, Green, Purple, or a related stone color without matching every part of the print
using White, Clear, or Black only when the resulting contrast remains formal in ceremony photos

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For a nine-year-old's short-notice princess party at a play venue, [X] prepares a charm-bracelet station and considers an additional bracelet gift, choosing bead, charm, and metal colors that feel grown-up enough for the child, remain distinguishable during assembly, and still belong in the party photographs.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为九岁孩子临时筹备游乐场地里的公主主题派对时，[X]会设置串饰手链工作台并考虑另送一条手链，需要选择既不会显得幼稚、组装时又易于区分，并能融入派对照片的珠子、挂饰和金属色彩。
examples: using Pink, Purple, White, Gold, or Silver for a recognizable but not toddler-like royal palette
offering Red, Orange, Yellow, Green, Blue, Navy, or Turquoise beads so children can make distinct take-home pieces
keeping Black, Brown, Beige, Gray, Bronze, Rose Gold, or Clear as controlled choices rather than mixing every option into one bracelet

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For an outdoor luncheon with twenty-five golf friends, [X] develops an original dress code with a shared palette and treats pearls, hoops, statement earrings, and other jewelry as the finishing layer that must read coherently across sunlight, movement, and group photographs.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为 25 位高尔夫球友的户外午宴设计带共同色彩规则的原创着装主题时，[X]会把珍珠、圈形耳环、醒目耳饰等首饰作为最后一层，要求它们在日光、活动和集体照片中保持协调。
examples: using White, Black, Red, Pink, Orange, or Green to reinforce one of the announced dress-code directions
using Gold, Silver, Rose Gold, or pearl White to connect accessories across different outfits without making them identical
allowing a bright Blue, Purple, Yellow, or Turquoise accent only when it remains legible rather than chaotic in the group photograph

scenarios.scenario_abstract: For an R&B concert at a dry stadium, [X] builds a comfortable streetwear outfit and evaluates layered chains, hoops, and rings with a venue-approved clear bag, checking which jewelry finish adds polish without creating a security problem or disappearing in low concert light.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为天气干燥的体育场 R&B 演唱会准备舒适街头造型时，[X]会同时评估叠戴链条、圈形耳环和戒指与场馆规定透明包的组合，检查哪种首饰色泽既能增加精致感，又不会带来安检问题或在昏暗灯光中失去存在感。
examples: using Gold or Silver to coordinate jewelry with the clear bag's chain strap
using Black, White, or a darker neutral finish when reflective pieces would draw unwanted attention in dense crowds
using a controlled Red, Blue, Green, Purple, or Pink accent only when it stays compatible with walking, dancing, and security screening

scenarios.scenario_abstract: To fill twenty-two tiny cubbies in a thrifted Southern Gothic shelf, [X] searches for miniature crosses, saint medals, rosary parts, lockets, cameos, mourning pieces, and old charms whose aged finishes alternate clearly across the small display without losing the religious and decayed mood.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 为了把淘来的南方哥特风小架子的 22 个微型格子填满，[X]会寻找小十字架、圣牌、念珠零件、吊坠盒、浮雕、悼念首饰和旧挂饰，让不同做旧色泽在狭小陈列中清楚交替，同时保留宗教感与衰败氛围。
examples: alternating Black, White, Red, Purple, Pink, or Green pieces to preserve the source's dark-versus-pale rhythm
using Gold, Bronze, Silver, Brown, or Gray through tarnish, brass, wood, old metal, and patina rather than fresh showroom shine
using Beige, Clear, Blue, Navy, Orange, Yellow, Rose Gold, or Turquoise only when a real thrifted bead, stone, glass piece, or metal finish supports it

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While planning a creative Bali weekend with a newly married partner, [X] compares a metal-jewelry workshop with other shared crafts, asking whether making matching rings or bracelets will produce a wearable memory and how the workshop's available metal and finish choices affect that result.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 与新婚伴侣规划创意巴厘岛周末时，[X]会比较金属首饰工作坊和其他共同手作活动，考虑制作配对戒指或手链能否留下可佩戴的纪念，并核对工作坊可提供的金属与表面色泽会如何影响成品。
examples: using Silver when the advertised local workshop is specifically a silver-jewelry class
considering Gold, Rose Gold, or Bronze only if the workshop documents plating or alternative metal routes
not inventing a completed matching pair when the source only proposes the activity

scenarios.scenario_abstract: While building an understated seasonal outfit item by item, [X] selects a pearl necklace and uploads it with the bag combination, then uses the actual image to judge whether the jewelry remains a subtle finishing accent beside the outfit's single brighter color.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 逐件搭建低调的季节性造型时，[X]会主动询问项链、选定珍珠项链并上传它与包的组合图片，再用实图判断首饰放在造型唯一较亮的颜色旁时是否仍是一处克制的点缀。
examples: keeping White when the shown pearl necklace should echo the clean base
comparing Silver or Gold only when the same restrained necklace role is preserved
rejecting a saturated Red, Pink, Green, Blue, or Purple necklace when it competes with the outfit's existing accent

scenarios.scenario_abstract: After rejecting a less personal book gift, [X] chooses a custom floral pendant necklace from an online maker, inspects the product image, calls the design perfect, pairs it with a selected candle, and reaches an order decision after checking that the necklace finish belongs in the two-gift composition.
scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 放弃不够私人的书籍礼物后，[X]会选定线上工匠制作的定制花卉吊坠项链，查看商品图片并确认设计合适，再搭配一支已选蜡烛，在核对项链色泽能否融入双礼物组合后决定下单。
examples: keeping Gold when the pictured chain and pendant are the design the user approved
checking Silver or Rose Gold only as a seller-provided version of the same floral design
not changing the confirmed finish merely to echo the candle's scent name or packaging

professional_scenarios.scenario_abstract: A designer building a client's classy minimalist jewelry shop from zero prepares a moodboard and catalog color standard, aligning backgrounds, accents, metal and stone filters, macro photography, lighting temperature, and on-screen naming so shoppers can compare real product colors consistently.
professional_scenarios.scenario_abstract_zh: 一名设计师从零为客户搭建高雅简约的首饰商城，并制作情绪板和商品色彩标准，统一背景、强调色、金属与宝石筛选、微距摄影、光源色温和页面命名，让顾客能够一致地比较真实商品颜色。
examples: separating Silver, Gold, Rose Gold, and Bronze filters instead of using one metallic label
keeping Black, White, Gray, Brown, and Beige backgrounds from changing the apparent product color
showing saturated, Turquoise, and Clear pieces under the same documented lighting and naming rules
